question: Why does carbenicillin have a low antibacterial activity by mouth ?:

options.opa: It is degraded by beta-lactamases in the digestive system.
options.opb: He undergoes first-pass hepatic oxidative metabolism.
options.opc: It binds covalently to plasma proteins.
options.opd: It is decarboxylated in the acid medium of the stomach giving rise to benzylpenicillin, which is also unstable in that medium.
options.ope: It is highly lipophilic, which is why it is not released correctly from oral administration forms.
